snippet.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Two classic Trails games return! Both The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero and The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure are coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 on September 10, 2026!

Whether you're returning to Crossbell or visiting for the first time, you'll get to experience a rich duology in the Trails series. Fight to overcome corruption as Lloyd Bannings and the rest of the Special Support Section do everything they can to save their home.

The new consoles can support enhanced visuals at up to 120 FPS and even up to 4k resolution! Use either the original or upscaled textures, and try out Mouse Mode on Nintendo Switch 2!

The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero and The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure will be sold separately digitally and together physically. Pre-order today!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.thelegendofheroes.com/crossbell/azure/

#TrailstoAzure #TrailsfromZero
